items.title: 7.4.4 Units of the rate constant (rate constant ki units) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.4.4, printed pages 157-158.

blocks.text: Rate constant kisi khaas reaction ke liye kisi khaas temperature par specific (khaas) hota hai. Concentrations mol dm⁻³ mein aur rate mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ mein hoti hai, is liye k ki unit reaction ke order aur time ki unit par depend karti hai.

blocks.text_alt: Rate = k[Reactants]ⁿ   where n = order of reaction

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'Rectants' chhapa hai; sahi lafz 'Reactants' hai.
Is equation se kisi bhi order ki reaction ke k ki unit nikal sakte hain: bas n ki jagah order rakhein.

blocks.text_alt: k = (mol dm⁻³)¹⁻⁰ s⁻¹;  k = mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹

blocks.text: First order reaction (n = 1) mein rate ek reactant ki concentration ke seedha proportional hoti hai:

blocks.text_alt: k = (mol dm⁻³)¹⁻¹ s⁻¹;  k = (mol dm⁻³)⁰ s⁻¹;  k = s⁻¹

blocks.text: Is liye first order rate constant ki unit s⁻¹ hai.

blocks.text_alt: k = (mol dm⁻³)¹⁻² s⁻¹;  k = mol⁻¹ dm³ s⁻¹;  k = dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹

blocks.text: Second order rate constant ki unit dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹ hai.

blocks.text_alt: k = (mol dm⁻³)¹⁻³ s⁻¹;  k = mol⁻² dm⁶ s⁻¹;  k = dm⁶ mol⁻² s⁻¹

blocks.text: Is liye third order rate constant ki unit dm⁶ mol⁻² s⁻¹ hai.

blocks.caption: Order ke mutabiq k ki units

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: k ki unit dekh kar order pehchana ja sakta hai: sirf s⁻¹ ho to first order, dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹ ho to second order.

blocks.prompt: a) In rate expressions ka overall (kul) order nikalein: i) rate = k[NO]²[NH₃]⁰ ii) rate = k[BrO₃⁻][Br⁻][H⁺]²
blocks.explanation: i) 2 + 0 = 2, yani second order. ii) 1 + 1 + 2 = 4, yani fourth order. (Kitab mein BrO₃ bina charge ke chhapa hai; bromate ion BrO₃⁻ hai.)

blocks.prompt: b) Chemists reaction ka order aur rate constant kyun jaanna chahte hain?
blocks.explanation: Order aur k se kisi bhi concentration par rate ka andaza lagaya ja sakta hai, industry mein kam kharch wali conditions (halaat) chune ja sakte hain, aur reaction ka mechanism (reaction ke step by step hone ka rasta) samjha ja sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Balanced equation ke coefficients ka sum (jama) order kyun nahi batata?
blocks.explanation: Order experiment se maloom hota hai aur mechanism, khaas taur par sab se slow step, par depend karta hai. Coefficients sirf total moles batate hain; maslan 2FeCl₃ + 6KI mein 8 molecules hain lekin order 3 hai.

items: Zero order: mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹; first: s⁻¹; second: dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹; third: dm⁶ mol⁻² s⁻¹.
